I posted the schedule for 2026-10-24.

It has one visit: Harold Davis's lizard Iggy (about 25 years old) for a respiratory check, with recurring sneezing since October 21. The booking system actually lists seven entries for Iggy, all with nearly identical reasons, so they look like duplicates. I noted that on the schedule so the front desk can cancel the extras. I also flagged the sneezing as possibly needing prompt attention, since it has recurred for several days in an elderly animal.
